# Abstract {#sec-abstract}




# Background {#sec-background}

Fantasy football has been the pinnacle of gambling, either by picking players to formulate a team, or to simply bet on another player. However, we aren't experts, so a lot of the issues that arise is from us not knowing the right players to choose, or the right thing to gamble on. Throughout my time being spent in a class where we deal with such, the psychology in statistics and human judgement, all of this can be encapsulated into a single idea.

## Research Question

The research question at hand may go both ways as an answer to such. But can we prove that our own R-code is a better, not certain, eliminator to the uncertainty?

## Hypothesis

I believe that our R-code can greatly eliminate the uncertainty. This is the only thing that drives us away from making those big bets (take this with a grain of salt, I am not an advisory for betting, or such betting). If we can get basic statistics on how players perform throughout their career, we can get a basic baseline to bet on.

However, this might be the one weakness that breaks this all, is where we can predict injuries, et cetera, but that will be a different conversation later.

## Justification

# Method {#sec-method}

## Code

```{r}
qbs_from_2015_2024 <- player_stats_weekly %>%
  filter(
    position == "QB",
    season >= 2015,
    season <= 2024
  ) %>%
  select(
    player_id,
    player_display_name,
    season,
    completions,
    attempts,
    passing_yards,
    passing_tds,
    passing_interceptions,
    fantasyPoints
  )
```

## Results and Findings

## Statistical Visulization

```{r}
example_player <- player_stats_seasonal %>%
  filter(player_display_name == "Josh Allen") %>% 
  distinct(player_id) %>% 
  pull(player_id)

example_player <- player_stats_weekly %>%
  filter(
    player_id == example_player,
    season == 2024
  )

ggplot2::ggplot(
  data = example_player,
  mapping = aes(x = week, y = fantasyPoints)
) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    x = "Week",
    y = "Fantasy Points",
    title = "Josh Allen Weekly Fantasy Points (2024 Season)"
)
```
